title: Cascade: Exploiting SLO-Aware latency budget for fair and high goodput LLM inference serving
abstract: arXiv:2608.06557v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The reasoning and agentic capabilities of LLMs have expanded the range of applications they support, from short interactive exchanges to long, prefix-heavy requests. LLM serving platforms today define response-latency service-level objectives (SLOs), yet requests under the same SLO differ by orders of magnitude in input length, generation length, execution cost, and reusable KV-cache availability, leaving each request with a different amount of latency headroom. This headroom must cover not only execution, but also scheduling and preemption delays and the cost of retrieving KV state from deeper memory tiers. Existing systems manage these decisions independently, despite their combined impact on latency.   We present Cascade, an LLM serving system that coordinates these decisions using a per-request latency budget: the difference between a request's SLO and its predicted remaining service time, continuously updated from request

translated_title: Cascade：利用SLO感知的延迟预算实现公平且高有效吞吐量的大语言模型推理服务
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的推理和智能体能力已经扩展了它们所支持的应用范围，从简短的交互式对话到漫长且前缀繁重的请求。如今的LLM服务平台定义了响应延迟的服务级别目标（SLO），然而在同一SLO下的请求在输入长度、生成长度、执行成本以及可重用KV缓存可用性方面相差数个数量级，导致每个请求拥有不同的延迟余量。这些余量不仅需要覆盖执行本身，还必须涵盖调度与抢占延迟，以及从更深层次内存层检索KV状态的成本。现有系统对上述决策进行独立管理，尽管它们对延迟具有综合影响。我们提出了Cascade，一个LLM服务系统，它使用每请求延迟预算来协调这些决策：该预算被定义为请求的SLO与其预测剩余服务时间之间的差值，并从请求（摘要在此处被截断）持续更新。
tldr: Cascade系统通过利用SLO感知的每请求延迟预算，统一协调调度、抢占和KV缓存分层管理等决策，实现了公平且高有效吞吐量（goodput）的LLM推理服务。
en_tdlr: Cascade is an LLM serving system that exploits SLO-aware per-request latency budgets to coordinate scheduling, preemption, and KV-cache tier management decisions, achieving fair and high-goodput LLM inference serving.
